subject: PO fields, net terms and consolidated invoice cadence — ACME Retail
messages:
From: Jill Armstrong <jill.armstrong@acme-retail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo earlier — ACME is interested in moving forward but procurement has a few mandatory requirements we need to confirm before issuing a PO. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 

- Accept a PO that requires monthly consolidated invoices instead of weekly statements?
- Support net60 payment terms (their current default is net30/net60 depending on contract)?
- Include GL code and remit-to address fields on invoices and on the PO? They want tax id, vendor remit address, and an explicit PO reference on each invoice for ERP matching.

Also, if we do annual committed spend with quarterly prepay, would Redwood support bucketized billing (i.e., allow a prepay to be consumed across multiple invoices) or do you require a single invoice per prepay?

Procurement would also like a template PO with the exact invoice fields you need. Can you send that and a short note on any discounts for quarterly or annual prepay?

Best,
Jill Armstrong
Senior Procurement Manager
ACME Retail

Attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Armstrong <jill.armstrong@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Jill — great to hear ACME is moving toward PO. Quick answers below and a couple of follow-ups so we can give you a clean PO template. I've attached our latest pricing deck so you have the committed/usage tiers in one place.

Summary answers:
- Consolidated monthly invoices: yes — we can do consolidated monthly invoices as standard for enterprise customers.
- Net60: we can accommodate net60, typically with a PO on file and a short credit check / preauth step for larger commitments. Net60 requests are often paired with a slight billing holdback until PO is validated in our system (operational only).
- Invoice fields: we can include Tax ID, Remit-to, and GL/Cost center on the invoice. We ask that the PO also contain a field called "invoice_to_gl" or similar so our ERP can map lines automatically.

On prepay / bucketization: we support quarterly prepay that gets applied as a credit balance against monthly invoices (i.e., one prepay can draw down over multiple invoices). We can also issue an initial invoice for the prepay and then zero-dollar monthly statements if you prefer.

Can you confirm procurement's required PO fields (exact label names) and whether ACME requires multiple POs per quarter or a single master PO with release lines? Once we have that I can send a PO template back.

Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood-pricing-deck-v3.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME procurement ask — discount & prepay options

Team — moving ACME toward a PO. Procurement wants net60 + monthly consolidated invoices + GL field. Key commercial levers: prepay (quarterly/annual) or committed monthly usage.

Options I think we can offer (draft):
- Standard: monthly invoice, net45, no prepay discount.
- Compromise A: monthly consolidated invoices, net60, 5% discount on committed annual spend (12-month term).
- Compromise B (prepay): quarterly prepay applied as bucketized credit + 7% discount on prepaid dollars. Requires us to accept single invoice for the prepay and then consume credit monthly.

Constraints to confirm with Finance & Legal:
- Are we comfortable with net60 exposure for a new acct at ACME size? Suggest we surface a 30-day auto-bill/lockbox guarantee (auto-draft if payment not received by day 45) to mitigate.
- Can Billing include an "invoice_to_gl" custom field to match their ERP?

Vanessa — given ACME's size, would you prefer to push for Compromise A or B? Ben / Karthik — any implications on discounts or approvals for net60 + 7% prepay?

Priyom

---internal note: do not forward outside Redwood until we finalize credit guardrails---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ACME procurement ask — discount & prepay options

Priyom — thanks, this looks good. My recommendation: lead with Compromise A (5% + net60) — less operational friction and faster PO execution. Offer Compromise B as a follow-up commercial sweetener if they push for better economics.

A few specifics we should include in the PO template:
- Required fields: PO number, PO date, account remit address, ACME tax id, Redwood vendor tax id (we'll include), invoice_to_GL (free-text), cost center, and an "invoice reference" that must match the PO line.
- Invoices cadence: monthly consolidated invoice, line items by service month, one tax summary per invoice.
- Prepay flow: if they prepay, we will issue a single invoice for the prepay amount with a credit memo applied monthly; ERP teams at some customers prefer the single prepay invoice plus zero-dollar statements for consumption months — we'll offer both.

I've attached a PO template tailored to ACME. Ben, please confirm whether Finance can accept net60 with the proposed auto-draft backstop at day 45. If Finance says yes, we can finalize language and send to Jill.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_template_ACME.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Armstrong <jill.armstrong@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Final: PO template and commercial offer for ACME (RDW-ACM-2026-72)

Hi Jill — thanks for the patience while we lined this up internally. Per our discussions, Redwood can proceed with the following commercial and operational terms for ACME (deal RDW-ACM-2026-72):

- Discount: 5% on committed spend for a 12-month term (applies to subscriptions and committed usage tiers).
- Payment terms: Net60. As a standard credit safeguard we request a PO on file and reserve the right to enable an auto-draft/lockbox at day 45 if invoices remain unpaid; this will be operationally coordinated by Billing.
- Invoice cadence: Consolidated monthly invoices with line-level PO references and one tax summary per invoice.
- PO fields required: PO number, PO date, remit-to address, ACME tax id, Redwood vendor tax id, invoice_to_GL (free-text), and cost center. Please ensure the PO references the deal id RDW-ACM-2026-72 on each invoice.
- Prepay option: If ACME prefers quarterly prepay, we can accept a single prepay invoice that will be applied as a credit and consumed over monthly statements; we can also issue monthly zero-dollar consumption statements if your ERP requires them. Prepay discount would be 7% on prepaid dollars (requires finance sign-off).

Attached: a filled PO template (PO_template_ACME.xlsx) and the SOW for the core inference services (sow-redwood-core-inference.pdf). For signature convenience, here's a DocuSign link to the Master Ordering Addendum: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-RDW-ACM-72

If this looks good, please return a signed PO (or the procurement-approved template) with the fields noted above and we will route to Billing for onboarding. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if procurement wants to walk through the PO mapping to their ERP.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
